messages:
maria: Quick async check — can folks drop 1-2 bullets on status for the warmup + continuous-batching sprint? Need owners, deps, and blockers for tomorrow's milestone. Goal: reduce p99 token latency ~20%

jordan: Kernel change in review to shorten the mutex hold in the hot path. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/542 — mostly tests failing on a race, pinging @li for a quick look. I expect to merge if CI green. :eyes:

li: I left comments on the PR, small nit around the spin loop. Can push a fix today EOD. I also want to run the perf bench locally against the 512-seq workload before merge.

sam: KV warmup experiment update: telemetry shows cold miss rate at ~38% for new shard config under burst. Trying a two-phase warmup (prefetch keys then progressive populate). Draft patch in my branch sam/kv-warmup-v2, still tuning thresholds. Blocking: need a reliable perf trace from staging with realistic request distribution.

anya: Continuous batching side — I raised the batch cap to 64 for the hotpath canary which reduces avg latency but tails remained for 512 seq inputs. I have a profiling dump: `heap: 30% time on memcpy in attention` — might be kernel memcpy hot spot. Looking into vectorized memcpy or chunked copies.

ryan: I can run the dedicated perf farm on that exact request trace. @maria please share the trace link and the exact commit sha to run. Also, if we want to test quantized kernels, I need the model artifact path.

maria: Trace and artifact: https://internal.ops/redwood/perf/trace/2026-03-16-hotpath.json and artifact sha: a1b2c3d. Please run batch of 1000 requests at 80% concurrency cap. Ryan — thanks for taking perf.

ci-bot: CI failed on runtime PR #542 — flaky test `TestKVEviction` on linux-rt-4. Re-run with `./scripts/ci rerun 542`

jordan: Re-ran CI, same flaky fail. I'm disabling the flaky test temporarily in the PR and filing a follow-up to stabilize it. Will post link to follow-up issue.

li: Updated PR with spin-loop fix and test skip comment. Pushed new commit, running local bench now. If things look good I'll merge and tag canary.

sam: For KV warmup, dependency: need the canary from kernel branch merged so warmup can rely on reduced memcpy tail. Otherwise the warmup improvements mask kernel regression. Blocker: kernel merge required.

anya: On batching, I also need thumbs from infra (autoscaler) to increase max burst by 2x for the canary window — otherwise we won't hit target throughput. @maria can we get approval?

maria: Approving infra burst increase for a 2h canary window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. Ryan — can you coordinate perf run during that window?

ryan: Yep, I've scheduled the perf job for 09:15 UTC. Will post results in this thread.

jordan: Owners/next steps (short):
- Kernel mutex/spin fix: jordan + li (PR 542) — merge planned today after bench.
- KV warmup experiment: sam — blocked on kernel merge + staging trace; will finalize thresholds after perf.
- Continuous batching tuning: anya — needs infra burst increase + kernel merge.
- Perf runs: ryan — scheduled 09:15 UTC tomorrow.

maria: Blockers called out. Please update the PR/issue links in this thread as you finish. If any slip, call it out ASAP so we can roll fallback model variant for the canary. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
